patch_description: This crossover keeps the current implementation’s demand-based direct-link rewards and sparse, selective two-hop path credit. It adds modest positive couplings for pairs of links that share an origin or destination, borrowing the load-balancing signal from the stronger endpoint-exposure implementation. Concave exposure scaling prevents high-volume nodes from dominating; the smaller path-coupling set keeps the quadratic model compact. The degree penalty remains external, with a weight chosen to discourage invalid topologies without adding degree terms here.
